answer: An agent economy can resist sybils the way a reef resists a fake tide: every identity must keep a beacon lit over time, a public and verifiable history of useful work that neighbours can check, while independent peers act as a mirror, reflecting each claim back against the shared record so invented histories show up as reflections with no source. A thousand fake lights are cheap to switch on once, but keeping a thousand beacons burning season after season, under a mirror that never blinks, costs more than the fraud is worth.
